gloss: to press against; to force upon

definitions.gloss: to press against; to push onto
definitions.explanation: To physically press something firmly against a surface.

definitions.gloss: to force upon; to push off onto
definitions.explanation: To impose unwanted tasks, responsibilities, or opinions on someone.

examples.japanese: スタンプを{紙|かみ}に{押|お}し{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I pressed the stamp onto the paper.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{考|かんが}えを{人|ひと}に{押|お}し{付|つ}けてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't force your ideas on other people.

examples.japanese: {面倒|めんどう}な{仕事|しごと}を{新人|しんじん}に{押|お}し{付|つ}けないでください。
examples.english: Please don't push the troublesome work onto the newcomers.

notes:
{押|お}し{付|つ}ける is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) formed from {押|お}す (to push) + {付|つ}ける (to attach). The figurative meaning of forcing things on people is very common.

ASPECT (ている):
{押|お}し{付|つ}けている indicates ongoing pressure or that something has been pressed/forced.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を[surface]に{押|お}し{付|つ}ける — to press [thing] against [surface]
- [person]に[thing]を{押|お}し{付|つ}ける — to force [thing] on [person]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (push responsibility onto)
- {仕事|しごと}を{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (push work onto)
- {意見|いけん}を{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (force one's opinion on)
- {自分|じぶん}の{価値観|かちかん}を{押|お}し{付|つ}ける (impose one's values)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {強制|きょうせい}する: to force, compel (more formal)
- {押|お}しつけがましい: pushy, overbearing (adjective form)
